description: Billing credit cent rounding and precision contract.
goal_template: Preserve exact billing credit cent-rounding behavior with the smallest safe implementation change: sum full creditDollars values and round the aggregate once to cents.
non_goals: Do not refactor unrelated billing helpers
Do not introduce broad BigInt/helper abstractions unless validation requires it
Do not change tests or validation expectations

requirements.must: The fix must satisfy the billing credit cent-rounding contract: do not floor, truncate, or round each row before summing; sum full numeric creditDollars values first, then round the aggregate once to the nearest cent. Required examples: 0.335 + 0.335 + 0.335 => 1.01, and 120.125 + 327.53 => 447.66.
negative_checks: Do not over-credit fractional cent boundaries
Do not keep per-row Math.floor/truncation before aggregation

requirements.must: The implementation must be scoped to allowed files only.
negative_checks: Do not edit unrelated billing files

requirements.must: Prefer a minimal arithmetic correction over a broad refactor.
requirements.verification: Diffstat stays within expected budget or a risk flag explains why.
negative_checks: Do not add broad helper without justification

implementation_plan.step: Inspect only allowed billing implementation files.
implementation_plan.expected_change: Locate any per-row cent floor/truncation or premature rounding.

Remove per-row floor/truncation and keep only final aggregate cent rounding. If JavaScript floating-point boundaries would make plain Math.round miss the required examples, a tiny local aggregate-rounding helper is allowed and is not a plan deviation.

implementation_plan.step: Run validation and produce self-audit trace.
implementation_plan.expected_change: No further code changes unless validation fails.

acceptance_rules: Diff budget is met or risk-flagged
No unresolved questions remain on pass
